scope.boundary: other-animals is the deterministic Animalia remainder after more-specific static-package routes. This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from exact Dicyemida root 3Z; every other other-animals-owned species is explicitly outside this sidecar.

mixedResourcePack.outOfScopeBoundary: All remaining accepted species in Other Animals are not Dicyemida and receive no ITIS Dicyemida match in this sidecar.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Use the valid ITIS Dicyemida order TSN 57410 as the sidecar root. Kantharella antarctica is retained as its exact current-species witness. Broader Rhombozoa TSN 563954 includes Heterocyemida-only Microcyema and Conocyema species, which are intentionally excluded rather than treated as Dicyemida.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Dicyemida species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Dicyemida species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Dicyemida species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Dicyemida species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk for the declared Dicyemida partition inside the mixed Other Animals resource pack. It is not a global dicyemidan checklist, final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. The complete ITIS-only current-species partition is in its own immutable JSONL gzip shard.
